strongest_outsiders.left_out_outside_every_span: Each left-out candidate above was judged on What qualifies blind to placement; none was left out for lacking a destination. Strongest outside any span by views: Mount Tarawera (27,293, review: a mountain with a closed/permit-only summit and no counted source, owner call), Katikati town (20,521, review), Matakana Island, Te Urewera National Park (inside the Te Urewera destination).

benchmark.applicable_to_bay_of_plenty: Rotorua Museum rejected (closed for strengthening to about 2027-28; exterior only), the same shape as the Queen Mary Hospital negative benchmark. Vehicles and operators rejected (Comvita Honey Tour, KG Kayaks, Diveworks, Motu River Jet Boat Tours, Golf Te Puke). Whakaari / White Island (landings suspended since 2019) rejected. Gateway towns whose draw is the journey beyond (Ōpōtiki, for the Motu Trail) kept at low rank as spots, with the trail standalone. Single geysers/pools inside a park (Pōhutu, Lady Knox, Champagne Pool) rejected as parts of Te Puia and Wai-O-Tapu, as the Crater Rim Walkway was part of Summit Road.
benchmark.result: pass for the Bay of Plenty-relevant items; no strong outsider was dropped without a concrete What-qualifies reason.
